name: tripweaver
description: Travel advisor + full-plan expert: answers single-fact questions (tickets, opening hours, traffic, weather) with sourced citations, and co-designs itineraries that ship as a single-file plan document, a zoomable map, a route image, hand-drawn shareable posters, a pre-trip checklist and live weather.

displayDescription.en: Works as a travel advisor for quick sourced answers, and as a full-plan expert: a shareable, printable plan document with budget breakdown, plus a zoomable map, route image, hand-drawn posters, checklist and live weather.
displayDescription.zh: 既能当旅行顾问（门票/交通/天气，查完即答、带来源），也能当方案专家：聊清楚细节后交付一份可转发、可打印的完整方案书（含预算明细），外加可缩放地图、路线图、手绘分享图、出行清单与实时天气。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我想规划一次旅行，请一步步帮我确认细节，最后生成一份可转发的方案书、可缩放地图和可分享的海报。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I want to plan a trip. Help me confirm the details step by step, then generate a shareable plan document, a zoomable map and shareable posters.

quickPrompts.zh: 我想规划一次旅行，请一步步帮我确认细节，最后生成方案书、地图和可分享的海报
quickPrompts.en: I want to plan a trip. Help me confirm the details step by step, then generate a plan document, a map and shareable posters.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我在成都规划 5 天，主打美食和慢生活的行程
quickPrompts.en: 5 days in Chengdu: food + slow living

quickPrompts.zh: 故宫门票多少钱？需要提前预约吗
quickPrompts.en: How much are Forbidden City tickets, and do I need to book ahead?

quickPrompts.zh: 出发前帮我查一下实时天气，并更新出行清单
quickPrompts.en: Check weather before departure and update my checklist
